title: CmdPal: Icons (12/n) - Share Shell icons by identity and display file-type previews

proposed_comments.title: Preserve the useful file-type preview when exact refinement falls back
proposed_comments.body:
### Preserve the useful file-type preview when exact refinement falls back

**Severity:** `medium`

When exact refinement returns the generic `ShellItemIconFallback`, this null-coalescing expression discards an already successful file-type preview. Preserve that useful preview unless refinement yields a real icon; cover the generic-fallback completion path with a regression test.

```suggestion
                return exact is not null && !ShellItemIconFallback.IsFallback(exact)
                    ? exact
                    : intermediate ?? exact;
```

confidence.rationale: The current null-coalescing selection accepts the non-null generic fallback before the more useful intermediate result.

proposed_comments.title: Recheck Shell image-list generation before sharing or extracting cached locations
proposed_comments.body:
### Recheck Shell image-list generation before sharing or extracting cached locations

**Severity:** `high`

**Affected code:** `src/modules/cmdpal/Microsoft.CmdPal.UI/Helpers/Icons/IconLoaderService.cs` (canonical-load arbitration and extraction).

**Problem:** The location can become stale after resolution, before joining a shared load, or while extraction runs; a reused system-image-list index can then publish the wrong icon even though lookup was generation-checked.

**Suggested change:** For `SystemImageList` identities, verify `ShellIconLocations.IsCurrent` immediately before joining an existing materialized load and again after extraction. If the generation changed, dispose of the stale extraction result, retry boundedly, and fall back to a path-specific identity rather than publishing a stale index. Keep cache lookup and publishing consistent with the same generation. This is a coordinated control-flow change, not a one-line guard.

**Verification:** Add a race test that invalidates during location resolution, shared-task join, and extraction, then run the focused CmdPal UI tests and inspect the icon produced after the index is reused.

confidence.rationale: The supplied or cached location can become stale between lookup, task sharing, and extraction while the design depends on generation-safe invalidation.

proposed_comments.title: Invalidate cached Shell identities on image-list update notifications
proposed_comments.body:
### Invalidate cached Shell identities on image-list update notifications

**Severity:** `high`

**Affected code:** `src/modules/cmdpal/Microsoft.CmdPal.UI/Helpers/Icons/ShellIconCacheInvalidator.cs` (notification registration, `SHChangeNotification_Lock`, and message handling).

**Problem:** An existing system-image-list entry may change without an association change. The registration requests only `SHCNE_ASSOCCHANGED` and the handler does not read the delivered event ID, so aliases can keep serving the old icon.

**Suggested change:** Register for both `SHCNE_ASSOCCHANGED` and `SHCNE_UPDATEIMAGE`; pass typed output pointers to `SHChangeNotification_Lock`, classify the actual event, unlock it, and invalidate the alias generation using a distinct update-image reason and diagnostic. Cover both events and unknown/failed locks with focused tests.

**Verification:** Build CmdPal UI and fire both notification kinds while a cached image-list icon exists; confirm the next request resolves the current icon.

confidence.rationale: System image-list replacement uses SHCNE_UPDATEIMAGE, which is absent from the registration and event classification.

proposed_comments.title: Avoid poisoning shared file-type aliases with path-specific fallback results
proposed_comments.body:
### Avoid path-specific file-type aliases (1/2)

**Severity:** `high`

If a provisional `FileType` lookup fails, this fallback must not cache the original item's path-specific location under the shared extension key. Otherwise a transient failure for one `.txt` file can affect every `.txt` request. Apply this together with part 2 so fallback extraction also stays provisional.

```suggestion
            ShellIconIdentity.FromItemPath(request.ItemPath, request.Jumbo),
            CacheRawRequestAlias: request.LocationMode != ShellItemIconLocationMode.FileType);
```

confidence.rationale: The resolver can store an ItemPath fallback beneath the request's shared FileType cache identity.

proposed_comments.title: Keep failed file-type lookup from extracting an item-specific thumbnail

confidence.rationale: The extractor falls through to the original item's thumbnail stream for failed provisional FileType lookups.

proposed_comments.title: Make direct-image thumbnail identities change when the file changes
proposed_comments.body:
### Make direct-image thumbnail identities change when the file changes

**Severity:** `medium`

**Affected code:** `src/modules/cmdpal/Microsoft.CmdPal.UI/Helpers/Icons/ShellItemIconLocator.cs` and `ShellIconIdentity` (direct-image thumbnail identity).

**Problem:** The thumbnail identity is based only on item path and size mode. Replacing image contents at the same path does not necessarily raise a Shell association or image-list notification, so the materialized thumbnail can stay stale.

**Suggested change:** Add a file version (for example, last-write UTC ticks) to `ShellIconIdentity.FromItemThumbnail`, include it in canonical cache identity, and make direct-image aliases non-cacheable so a subsequent request reads that version again. Keep error handling for inaccessible or missing files explicit and add a same-path image-overwrite regression.

**Verification:** Build CmdPal UI, request a thumbnail, replace the file without renaming it, request again, and confirm the new image is displayed.

confidence.rationale: The current identity contains only path and size mode, neither of which changes when the image contents are replaced.

proposed_comments.title: Use the real binary-icon parser before excluding legacy Shell paths
proposed_comments.body:
### Parse the index before excluding a legacy Shell path

**Severity:** `medium`

The first-comma split treats `C:\folder.exe,assets\report.txt` as a binary icon reference even though `assets\report.txt` is not an icon index, so a valid file path misses Shell classification. Reuse the existing binary-icon parser, which rejects a nonnumeric suffix, and add that path to classifier coverage.

```suggestion
        return IconPathParser.TryParseBinaryIconReference(value, out _);
```

confidence.rationale: The heuristic validates the binary-looking prefix but not the comma suffix, unlike the existing parser.

proposed_comments.title: Disable Shell alias caching when change notifications are unavailable
proposed_comments.body:
### Disable Shell alias caching when change notifications are unavailable

**Severity:** `medium`

**Affected code:** `src/modules/cmdpal/Microsoft.CmdPal.UI/Helpers/Icons/ShellIconCacheInvalidator.cs` and `ShellIconLocationCache` (notification-registration failure and alias reads/writes).

**Problem:** When desktop PIDL resolution or Shell notification registration fails, the alias cache still accepts and serves path-to-image-list locations. Normal adaptive expiry is not a correctness invalidation boundary for an image-list entry that can be renumbered meanwhile.

**Suggested change:** Disable and clear alias reads/writes when registration fails; after a later successful registration, re-enable caching only for newly resolved locations. Wire both failure paths to the same cache state transition, including re-registration after Shell restart. Test registration failure and recovery while a cached alias exists.

**Verification:** Build CmdPal UI, simulate registration failure, request the same item after a Shell image-list change, and confirm no stale alias is returned.

confidence.rationale: The alias cache has no correctness TTL, so the logged promise of normal expiry cannot prevent stale Shell identity reuse.
